# Signatories

## Project team

Samuel Bharti, doctoral researcher at the University of Alabama at Birmingham, leads the work. I build R packages and Shiny applications for omics data, teach R to biologists, and worked before at Posit and at Genentech. Relevant public work:

- r-for-beginners (<https://github.com/samuelbharti/r-for-beginners>): Software Carpentry's r-novice-gapminder lesson rebuilt as 14 focused lessons with slides, published as a Quarto site with a Zenodo DOI.
- bioclients, biohttp and biobouncer: three R packages on CRAN and r-universe with Quarto tutorials and slide decks written for a workshop.
- Every package I maintain publishes its documentation through GitHub Actions to GitHub Pages, which is the wiring this project packages for tutorial authors.

I commit 200 hours over eight months.

Shaurita D. Hutchins, PhD candidate in genetics, genomics and bioinformatics at the University of Alabama at Birmingham, co-leads the project.
